faqTitle: Key questions before starting an international matter.
faqIntro: Clear, verified answers on how RRYP Global operates, our Spanish offices, entry routes and cross-border coordination.
faq1Q: What does it mean that RRYP Global builds cases from scratch and restructures complex proceedings?
faq1A: Before filing a claim or entering negotiations, we engineer the evidentiary, documentary and international jurisdiction framework of your case. We also take over stalled, inherited or complex proceedings to audit procedural risks, rebuild the evidentiary record and redirect strategy before Spanish courts.
faq2Q: Where are RRYP Global's offices located and how do you serve Marbella and the Costa del Sol?
faq2A: RRYP Global operates three offices in Spain: Madrid (Pº de la Castellana 40, 8ª, 28046), Málaga (C/ Martínez Campos 16, 3D, 29001) and Córdoba (Avda. Sta. Mª de Trassierra 98, 14011). Marbella and the Costa del Sol are served directly from our Málaga office.
faq3Q: How much does an initial consultation cost and what are the engagement options?
faq3A: We offer three transparent entry routes: a complimentary 30-minute initial call (no legal assessment) to confirm fit; a 30-minute First Legal Consultation with firm leadership for 350 € VAT included; and Urgent Attention for 500 € when facing imminent deadlines or cross-border emergencies.
faq4Q: Can you represent me in Spain if I live abroad and which languages do you speak?
faq4A: Yes. We regularly advise and litigate for clients of over 26 nationalities residing outside Spain via video conference, notarized or consular powers of attorney and direct coordination with foreign counsel. We work in Spanish, English, German, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese.
faq5Q: What happens if court proceedings are already open in another country?
faq5A: We immediately assess international lis pendens, jurisdiction and applicable law under EU Regulations and international treaties such as the Hague Convention, coordinating with foreign counsel under a single unified strategy to prevent conflicting rulings.
faq6Q: Which practice areas does RRYP Global focus on and what are your office hours?
faq6A: We focus on Private Clients (international family, custody, child abduction, cross-border estates and exequatur), Private Wealth (high-net-worth asset division, digital assets and prime real estate) and Business Disputes (international commercial litigation, shareholder disputes and judgment enforcement). Madrid office hours: Monday to Thursday 09:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 19:15; Friday 08:00 to 15:00 (+34 957 858 952).
